record_sources.anomaly_concurrent_queue: a local stageB queue (pid in stageB/QUEUE_RUNNING) completed sb_cnt10_e5_r{1,2,3} locally while this analysis ran (new DONE markers + manifests); per the freeze their canonical source stays the cluster thinned copy and the local full-density copies are cross-checks; the queue's cnt10 e20/e200 local runs were still in flight and are part of no record here

lift_subsampling.rule: EVERY frame of the committed record at the 12-ps thinned cadence -- NO analysis subsampling beyond the record's own thinning; local 1-ps records are downsampled to the same 12-ps cadence (uniform protocol), their full density used by arm 2 (dense) with the dense-vs-subsampled agreement recorded
lift_subsampling.note: the 20-30 s/lift worst case in the task brief was measured at 0.10-0.17 s/lift on this box, so full coverage is affordable and used

block_protocol.verified: thinned timesteps 0..12,000,000 (12 ps); local prod.dump timesteps 0..12,000,000 (1 ps)
block_protocol.primary: block B (stage_b_plan.md section 3.2: block A retains ~27-31% of the switch-on transient)
block_protocol.e0_blocks: 2 x 6 ns per run, both clean (field stays 0)

meta.floors: D15 max(mean, P90) over |Delta| between e0 block pairs from different runs of THIS batch (12 cross-run pairs per tube; 6 ns blocks -- like-for-like, supersedes the Stage A 1-ns floors)

detection_criteria.A_ordered_3x_floor: |mean_on(B) - mean_off| > 3 x D15 cross-run e0 floor (unpaired; runs the units)
detection_criteria.B_build_paired: |mean(on(B) - same-build e0 all-block mean)| > 3 x sem over the 3 builds (2x also recorded); secondary, owner's call
